title: #184 Foreign Languages
prompt: While artificial intelligence becomes so advanced, people can use computers to translate foreign languages. That makes learning a foreign language unnecessary. To what extent do you agree with it?

That makes learning a foreign language unnecessary.
To what extent do you agree with it?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
